description: This file contains unit tests for the ModuleConfigDTD in the org.openmrs.module.dtd package, specifically testing validation of XML configuration files against a DTD, using JUnit 5 parameterized tests.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_2
classes.description: A test class containing parameterized tests for validating different XML configuration scenarios using DTD validation.

methods.name: filterWithAllValuesSet
methods.description: Tests XML validation with a complete filter element with all expected attributes and init parameters.

methods.name: filterValidWithoutInitParams
methods.description: Validates that a filter element without init parameters (or with some missing) is accepted or rejected based on schema rules.

methods.name: filterInvalidWhenMissingFilterName
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when the filter name attribute is missing.

methods.name: filterInvalidWhenMissingFilterClass
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when the filter class attribute is missing.

methods.name: filterInvalidWithInitParamNameMissing
methods.description: Checks validation behavior when an init param lacks a name.

methods.name: filterInvalidWithInitParamValueMissing
methods.description: Checks validation behavior when an init param lacks a value.

methods.name: filterMappingWithUrlPattern
methods.description: Tests the validation of a filter mapping with a URL pattern.

methods.name: filterMappingWithServletName
methods.description: Tests the validation of a filter mapping with a servlet name.

methods.name: filterMappingWithBothUrlPatternAndServletNameFails
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when both URL pattern and servlet name are provided, which should be exclusive.

methods.name: filterMappingWithNeitherUrlPatternOrServletNameFails
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when neither URL pattern nor servlet name is provided in filter mapping.
